format: Simplified: one street, equity realisation. HU flop, BTN (opener, IP) vs BB (caller, OOP), single-raised pot, BB checks. Pot = 1. Check-check and called bets are settled by exact flop equity (all turn+river runouts); BB realises 90% of its equity, BTN the rest. Ranges: full preflop ranges (BTN open, BB flat call) minus board blockers.
solver: CFR+ (regret-matching+, alternating updates, linear averaging), stops below 0.05% pot exploitability
